note: Xbox Wire 3 Nov 2026 15:05Z (Joe Skrebels): The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel official name reveal, with the Bethesda Game Studios 40 years post carrying a fresh teaser (Verge 15:07Z). Confirms the 30 Oct report (The Verge). Footage: the teaser itself is an embed with no reachable file yet (IGN copy not up, Xbox Wire embed only); the Reel uses the official title card art composed on a 9:16 ground (full-frame, a 9:16 crop would cut the title). pace_ok: same title card alternates between two grounds. Release date and platforms not stated in the sources and not claimed. (re-run after the images landed on main)
